dropped.claim: The January 2026 capital raise of approximately $320M transforms the near-term liquidity picture, addressing the critical insolvency risk highlighted in the draft thesis, but the company remains a binary, pre-commercial investment entirely dependent on PARADIGM Trial results that won't be available for at least 12-18 months. With the trial now enrolling, this transitions from a 'Pass' based on imminent capital exhaustion to 'Watch' pending three critical milestones: completion of the first 200-patient cohort without safety signals, successful IDE supplement approval for full enrollment, and initial efficacy signals from interim data. The 82.3% dilution in 2025 and further dilution from the 2026 raises mean existing shareholders have absorbed massive dilution pre-data. The technical insolvency (stockholders' equity of -$93,000 at year-end 2025) and operating cash burn of -$77.8M demonstrate execution risk, while revenue decline to $1.9M and R&D at 3613.2% of revenue show this is purely a clinical development story. The ADAPT tissue's 10-year calcium-free track record in 55,000+ patients in other indications and early hemodynamic data from 130 DurAVR implants provide scientific rationale, but the $9.9 billion market opportunity faces entrenched competitors with substantially greater resources. Verdict: Watch for PARADIGM Trial enrollment progress, safety data from the initial cohort, and IDE supplement approval over the next 6-12 months before reassessing.
